# Horizontal Bars

Simple three-row bar chart with a header row.

```mdf-bar-chart
key,value
Build,40
Test,25
Ship,10
```

Horizontal alias with close values.

```mdf-horizontal-bar-chart
key,value
Alpha,12
Beta,11
Gamma,10
Delta,9
Epsilon,8
```

Long labels that force label and bar fitting.

```mdf-horizontal-bar-chart
key,value
North America Enterprise Renewals,188
Europe Platform Migration,124
APAC Developer Adoption,92
Internal Tooling,47
```
